target_customer: Early-stage startup founders who pay a monthly subscription for weekly accountability and investor-update reporting
problem: Founders drift from their highest-impact work and report poorly to investors. Pre sets a 10-week goal, connects the founder's tools and pushes weekly outcome-focused check-ins.
business_model: B2C/prosumer SaaS subscription for founders (listing shows about $84 per month)
product_category: AI accountability and execution coach for founders

founders.name: Darius Monsef
previous_startups: COLOURlovers / Creative Market (YC W10, acquired by Autodesk)
Brave Care (YC S19, pediatric urgent care, raised a reported $40M)
Genie (AI sidekick for kids, wound down 2025)
founders.background_notes: Described by the YC page as a full-stack operator and serial founder in Portland, Oregon.

founders.name: Asa Miller
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an engineer of 0 to 1 products.

exit.reason: Not stated publicly. YC directory shows Inactive.

technical_complexity.rationale: A thin LLM layer over tool integrations and check-in workflows; small team could ship it quickly in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Prompted coaching on top of public models and integrations is copyable in weeks, and no data or network lock-in is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No evidence in sources that an incumbent targeted this niche; later entrants such as FocusNinja and Founder Coach (2026) appeared.

market_need_then: Founders buy coaching and accountability programs, and the founder's own Pre-Accelerator coaching page shows paid demand for a human version, but no source quantifies demand for the AI product.

branding.domain_note: Uses buildwithpre.com rather than an exact short .com.

identity.logo: Simple icon and wordmark per directory listings
identity.voice_and_tone: Demanding and outcome-focused: tracks outcomes and holds you to a higher standard.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt listing exists under the name pre 2; no evidence of memes or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word 'Pre' collides with many other products and searches for it return unrelated brands; no press about the brand itself.

pivots.from: Genie, an AI sidekick for kids
pivots.to: Pre, an AI accountability agent for founders
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page lists both products and Genie was later shut down (March 2025) despite 22,000 installs per the founder.

outcome_analysis: Pre came out of a serial founder's YC S24 run, which began as the kids AI app Genie and then moved to a founder accountability agent. The YC directory marks it Inactive, but no shutdown post, cause or date is public, so the cause is not public. The funding found is a roughly $650K pre-seed that GeekWire tied to Genie, not Pre. The product was a thin, easily copied coaching layer in a niche that later attracted other small entrants, which is consistent with a stall, but the cause is unconfirmed.
notes: buildwithpre.com returned HTTP 503 when fetched. Funding of $650K (GeekWire, one outlet snippet) and $500K (VCBacked, different count) relate to Genie, so they are recorded as a single partial round and are unverified for Pre. Some aggregators still showed the product as listed in March 2026 while YC says Inactive. Cause of inactivity not found.
